hooks.command: echo '--- SurePath Session Start ---' && echo 'Branch: '$(git -C "$PWD" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown') && echo '' && echo 'Last 3 commits:' && git -C "$PWD" log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null && echo '' && if [ -f "$PWD/.memory/CONTEXT.md" ]; then echo '--- Last Context ---' && cat "$PWD/.memory/CONTEXT.md"; fi
